title: feat: consume dynamic runtime branding across the console frontend
body:
## Summary
- Replaces all hardcoded default icons, titles, and favicon with values from the runtime config branding endpoint
- Branding surfaces updated: header logo, auth page BrandMark, device-auth page, loading screen, PWA manifest, document title, favicon
- Pre-React branding script in `index.html` prevents flash of unbranded content
- `BrandingSync` React component keeps title + favicon in sync on every route change
- Dev-only Vite plugin serves branding assets at `/runtime/assets/*` from host project directory
- Falls back to built-in defaults when no branding is configured
- E2E smoke test made brand-agnostic

## Test plan
- [ ] Set `OS_PRODUCT_NAME`, `OS_LOGO_URL`, `OS_FAVICON_URL` and verify all surfaces
- [ ] Verify defaults still work when no env vars are set
- [ ] Hard-refresh page — title should not flash old default
- [ ] Run `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console dev` — /runtime/assets/logo.png should resolve

Made with [Cursor](https://cursor.com)
